why: Large Discord communities break small teams when support volume scales faster than people can respond.
The visible problem is repeated questions, delayed answers, escalation burden, and humans staying on-call all the time.
how: Lucius learns from historical Discord conversations, repeated questions, and prior human resolution patterns.
Lucius keeps improving through live interactions and escalation feedback instead of freezing after setup.
what: Lucius becomes an autonomous Discord support teammate that handles most repetitive support work.
Lucius keeps coverage running and escalates edge cases when needed.
highlights: Lucius basically gave me my holidays back.
audience: Buyers who understand Discord as a support surface
nonGoals: Do not invent internal queue counts or response-time metrics.
Do not turn the ending into a CTA.
Do not make the story about abstract AI magic.
